sources.product: NASA SRTM Global 1 arc-second (SRTMGL1 V003) or global 3 arc-second (SRTMGL3 V003)
sources.access: NASA LP DAAC / Earthdata Search; Earthdata account may be needed for protected cloud objects
sources.use: Earth elevation, slope, local relief, and roughness in covered latitudes
sources.caveats: SRTM coverage is approximately 60 degrees N to 56 degrees S; radar-derived elevation can include vegetation/building surfaces and voids. Match analysis scales to planetary grids.

sources.product: ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003
sources.use: Supplementary Earth elevation coverage, especially outside SRTM latitude limits
sources.caveats: Optical stereo DEM with known artifacts; compare quality masks and avoid treating it as identical to a bare-earth terrain model.

sources.access: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
sources.use: Lunar elevation and derived terrain summaries
sources.caveats: Product contains multiple grids and map products; choose projection/resolution and product labels explicitly.

sources.product: NASA GSFC PGDA A New View of the Lunar South Pole from LOLA, LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ
sources.access: NASA GSFC PGDA cloud-optimized GeoTIFF; supports HTTP range reads
sources.use: Slater Plain SP01 regional elevation and terrain metrics at finer scale than the uploaded 240 m LOLA grid
sources.caveats: Nominal pixel spacing is 20 m, but LOLA track density varies and cells are interpolated. Use effective-resolution/count/error layers when available; crop is regional context centered on SP01, not the candidate-region polygon. Cite Barker et al. 2023, Planetary Science Journal 4, 183.

sources.use: Lunar surface thermal observations and selected thermal-infrared material indicators
sources.caveats: Separate day/night products, local-time and illumination effects, temporal mapping cycles, and product uncertainty/count layers must be retained.

sources.product: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Records
sources.use: Global Mars elevation at several posted resolutions
sources.caveats: Gridded altimetry resolution and effective spatial support differ from Earth DEMs; account for scale before comparing terrain metrics.

sources.product: USGS HRSC/MOLA blended global DEM v2, 200 m/pixel
sources.access: USGS Astrogeology; product page provides GeoTIFF
sources.caveats: Large global raster (about 11 GB); HRSC component is CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO and MOLA is CC0. Preserve attribution and share-alike requirements where applicable.

sources.product: MODIS/Terra MOD11A1 V061 daily 1 km land surface temperature and emissivity
sources.use: Quality-screened Earth land surface temperature distributions, day/night
sources.caveats: Land surface temperature is not air temperature; cloud/quality filters and observation time matter. Earth atmosphere and hydrology make direct planetary equivalence impossible.

sources.access: Research dataset download from University of Hamburg
sources.use: Coarse lithological context for Earth candidate screening
sources.caveats: Global generalized classes are not a mineralogical match to orbital spectral data; use as context and validate promising sites locally.
